findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 3 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 40 questions numbered 1-40; by section: 3.1 5, 3.2 35.

Covers every part of the chapter in book order; every "difference" answer is a two-column table; answers are 2-4 lines or a short program with its output. None repeats the chapter exercise (what OOP is, purpose of a class, class vs object, purpose of __init__, what encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism are and why they help are left to the exercise). All programs were run in Python 3 and the outputs shown are their real outputs or errors. Book correction followed: a private member has two underscores (Figure 3.2).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
